name: mc_verify
title: Exact build verification
description:
Freezes the final eligible cells of a build before placement and checks the actual world against that immutable expectation afterward. Detects missing/unexpected blocks, wrong materials/properties and supported sign text/appearance. Never places blocks.

WHEN TO USE: prepare BEFORE mc_build, especially for keep/filters, then check the returned planId after building or editing. Use mc_repair with the fresh comparisonId to repair selected mismatches. WHEN NOT TO USE: preview images (mc_plan), arbitrary inventories/NBT or persistent project revision history. Do not reevaluate a filtered build after placement and mistake skipped cells for a successful verification.

PARAMETERS: action prepare/check/list/delete. prepare accepts build with exactly the mc_build schema; saved blueprints/transforms are supported. check requires planId, mode exact (default) or placement, and diagnostic limit 1-1000 (default 100). Exact checks every canonical state property. Placement explicitly excludes derived connection directions/wall-up/stair-shape only when the captured build connects blocks; chest types remain exact. Full cell counts/comparison are never truncated by the diagnostic limit. All returned coordinates are absolute.

SIDE EFFECTS: reads can load chunks; bookkeeping is bounded in memory, owner-scoped, expires after two hours and is lost on plugin reload/restart. No world writes, snapshots or blueprint changes. Skipped/untouched cells, entities, rich sign styling and arbitrary NBT are outside scope. Observation is tick-budgeted, not an atomic world lock. IDs are stale after a newer check; repairs always recheck observed values.

build.description: Authoritative mc_build schema populated at registration.
